tracks.name: 2-3 clave
tracks.code: s "<[~ claves:1 claves:1 ~] [claves:1 ~ ~ claves:1 ~ ~ claves:1 ~]>" # gain 1

tracks.name: Congas (tumbao)
tracks.code: mask "<f!4 t!12>" $ s "congas:0 congas:1 congas:12 congas:1 congas:0 congas:1 congas:6 congas:22" # gain "0.75 0.65 1 0.65 0.75 0.65 1 1" # pan 0.4

tracks.name: Bongo (martillo)
tracks.code: mask "<f!4 t!4 f!8>" $ s "bongos:0 bongos:6 bongos:2 bongos:6 bongos:0 bongos:6 bongos:16 bongos:7" {- # gain "0.95 0.75 0.9 0.75 0.95 0.75 1 0.75" -} # pan 0.6

tracks.name: Piano (guajeo)
tracks.code: superimpose (|- n 12) $ n "<[~ c6 a5 ~ e6 c6 ~ f6] [~ d6 a5 ~ f6 d6 ~ e6] [~ b5 gs5 ~ d6 b5 ~ f6] [~ d6 a5 ~ f6 d6 ~ e6]>" # s "bright_acoustic_piano_fluid" # legato 0.9 # gain 0.6 # room 0.89 # lpf 4000

tracks.name: Bongo bell
tracks.code: mask "<f!8 t!8>" $ s "[cowbells:11 cowbells:9]*4" # gain "[1 0.7]*4" # pan 0.6

tracks.name: Coro
tracks.code: mask "<f!8 t!4 f!2 t!2>" $ n "<~ [~ ~ [d5,f5] [d5,f5] ~ [c5,e5] ~ ~]>" # s "choir_aahs_fluid" # legato 0.9 # gain 0.9 # room 0.3
